title: Structural and energetic insights into cGAS-DNA monomer and oligomer formation: an MD and mM/GBSA study.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD和MM/GBSA模拟研究cGAS-DNA单体与寡聚体形成的结构及能量机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作体系，方法为物理模拟，虽非典型TF-DNA但机制建模可借鉴。
abstract: Upon binding to cytosolic DNA, the cyclic GMP-AMP synthase (cGAS) is activated to catalyze the synthesis of cGAMP, which then activates downstream effectors and induces innate immune responses. The activation of cGAS relies on the formation of cGAS-DNA oligomers and liquid phase condensation, which are sensitive to the length and concentration of DNA. Although significant progresses have been made for the understanding of such a length- and concentration-dependent activation, some structural and energetic details of the cGAS-DNA oligomerization remains elusive. Here, with molecular dynamics simulations, we report the structure of the cGAS-DNA monomer (the cGAS(1)-DNA(1) complex), in which the DNA binds simultaneously to the major parts of two DNA-binding sites as observed in the cGAS-DNA dimer (the cGAS(2)-DNA(2) complex) and its active site is largely immature. Energetic analysis indicates that two cGAS(1)-DNA(1) complexes are just slightly less stable than the cGAS(2)-DNA(2) complex and there exists a significant energy barrier for the formation of the cGAS(2)-DNA(2) complex from two cGAS(1)-DNA(1) complexes, which provides thermodynamic and kinetic explanations for an experimental observation that cGAS-DNA oligomerization is unfavored in low concentration of cGAS and DNA.
abstract_zh: 胞质DNA结合后，环状GMP-AMP合酶（cGAS）被激活，催化合成cGAMP，进而激活下游效应因子并诱导先天免疫反应。cGAS的激活依赖于cGAS-DNA寡聚体的形成及液相凝聚，这些过程对DNA的长度和浓度敏感。尽管在理解这种长度和浓度依赖性激活方面已取得显著进展，但cGAS-DNA寡聚化的某些结构和能量细节仍不明确。在此，通过分子动力学模拟，我们报道了cGAS-DNA单体（cGAS(1)-DNA(1)复合物）的结构，其中DNA同时结合到两个DNA结合位点的主要部分，正如在cGAS-DNA二聚体（cGAS(2)-DNA(2)复合物）中所观察到的，且其活性位点大部分未成熟。能量分析表明，两个cGAS(1)-DNA(1)复合物仅比cGAS(2)-DNA(2)复合物略不稳定，且从两个cGAS(1)-DNA(1)复合物形成cGAS(2)-DNA(2)复合物存在显著能垒，这为实验观察到的在低浓度cGAS和DNA下cGAS-DNA寡聚化不利提供了热力学和动力学解释。
